facts.fact: The African Development Bank's country strategy paper, dated December 2022, refers to an existing integrated ICT Sector Strategic Plan (2014-2024) that aims to transform Djibouti into an information society hub (document published 2023-01-01; statement dated to the paper's December 2022 date).
The paper gives the integrated ICT Sector Strategic Plan a period of 2014 to 2024.
